## Description {#details}

Struct template for SFINAE requirements.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="Cond">The boolean condition to be checked at compile time.</ParametersListItem>

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/requires-">requires&#95;</Link></code> struct template is a utility for SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error) in template metaprogramming. It is typically used to enable or disable template specialisations and function templates based on compile-time boolean conditions.

When the boolean template parameter is <code>true</code>, the specialisation provides a nested <code>type</code> alias, which can be used in conjunction with <code>typename</code> and <code><Link to="/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/#a1cbbf299a006b4692df250ef2a6fc7c2">requires&#95;t</Link></code> to enforce requirements in template declarations.
